why: One declaration per subscription provider is everything Brama needs to buy, prove, hand over and lease its accounts: the Weles provider whose declared purchase trajectory buys one, the names in numeric-provenance.json of the operator's account cap and of how many sessions may share one subscription, and for each coding-agent harness the harness's own name for the provider and the model a session on that provider starts on. A provider absent here, or missing any of these, is refused by the missing piece; nothing else in Brama names a provider.

omp.providerWhy: omp names Anthropic's subscription accounts `anthropic` (omp login anthropic, omp usage accounts).
omp.modelWhy: omp resolves `--model anthropic/opus` by fuzzy match to the newest Opus its catalog lists, the model the coding-agent sessions on claude-code subscriptions run on.

omp.providerWhy: The public usage report identifies Codex subscriptions as openai-codex.
The public usage report identifies Kimi subscriptions as kimi-code.
